lines.line: The last part of Aero is a climb, up platforms that rise out of the white.
Four memories are waiting along the route.
To reach the next platform, you can jump across the gap, or throw your head over to it.
Wherever your head lands, your body grows back around it.
Once you have found all four memories, you roll your head into the pipe, and it takes you home.
Aero. You can play it at M P T S dot I E, slash games, slash Aero.
